notes: Military camo names are only published as "Military Camo 1" to "Military Camo 8", so military_names is null. Special camo unlock levels are not published by either source, so level is null. Where Game Rant and CODMunity disagree or Game Rant lists TBD, the CODMunity value is used and both are recorded in the weapon notes. Gold, Platinum and Harmonic Break are published per class by Game Rant and per weapon by CODMunity; the two agree except where noted.
